title: The *Absent* Owner
dek: The agent stack got a browser, 6,000 prebuilt roles, a registration deadline, and a self-managed compute orchestrator. No one is accountable for the whole.

still_signal: Each layer built this week delegated accountability downstream. Cloudflare: no auth. IBM sells the governance. NY checks what labs report. The stack has owners and no accountable party.
